emitters_from: Ours, marked. MU's Atlans has no light but its TerrainLight (no CreateFire, no AddTerrainLight, ZzzObject.cpp:4055-4084). A faint teal pool round each stone, breathing with its glyph, after the Lost Tower's lamp posts; the user likes these faint. Then the user, 2026-10-03: 'atlans light sources actualy has to make light, so if char swims inside light source we can see it': raised to light a figure inside it. At 0.2-0.5 a figure inside read the same as one outside, under Atlans's bright overhead key; 0.6-0.8. And `wrap` 1: a figure standing in the pool took none of it, its sides edge-on to a light over it (the user, 2026-10-03: 'chat is standing on light source but is not receiving that light'); wrapped, it is lit round as in water.
